parallel_jobs_basis: User-approved MVP: one concurrent job; not execution authorization.

target_revision.reason: Approved target commit and legal repository/tool access are not supplied.

agent_access.reason: Codex/pi versions, models, authorization methods, host resources and installation availability have not been verified.

repository_permissions.reason: Local ticket editing does not authorize future pilot writes, network access or tool execution.

task_cost.reason: Approved numeric per-task amount and currency required, including local opportunity or provider costs.

campaign_cost.reason: Approved numeric campaign ceiling and currency required.

daily_cost.reason: Approved numeric daily ceiling and currency required.

budget_owner.reason: Authenticated accountable budget owner identity not supplied; user is the input owner, not assumed payer.

decision_owner.reason: Authenticated final decision owner identity not supplied.

source_allowlist.reason: Specific documents, Telegram channels and lawful permissions not supplied.

research_question.reason: Pilot topic approved; exact geography, time interval, populations and causal estimand not supplied.

freshness_windows.reason: Numeric maximum age per source category requires approval.

quality_thresholds.reason: Baseline, quality minimum, coverage floor, non-inferiority delta and statistical decision rule require preregistration.

independent_reviewer.reason: Independent qualified reviewer identity and conflict-of-interest checks not supplied.
